We have a Berlin defense of the Ruy Lopez ( 1 e4 e5 2 Nf3 Nc6 3 Bb5 Nf6 ), one of the most thoroughly analyzed openings in modern chess. The Berlin famously helped Vladimir Kramnik dethrone Garry Kasparov in their 2000 world title match in London and has been a staple of elite chess ever since, earning a reputation as one of black’s most reliable weapons against 1 e4.
